name: Dice
description: Adds a Roll permission and a roll command. A member who holds the permission can roll dice notation (NdM, optionally +/-K) and see each individual roll plus the total.

changes: Spaces around the modifier are accepted, so 2d20 + 3 works.
Rolls are random each time instead of repeating the same number.
The result repeats the notation you rolled.

author: slim-m

permissions.name: Roll dice
permissions.description: Roll dice notation and post the result.

extension_points.name: roll
extension_points.description: Roll the given dice notation, e.g. 2d20+3.
